messages:
Ethan (sales): quick sync - Acme financial POC. Need final acceptance criteria + model plan by EOD for SOW.
Leah (eng): customer asks: long-policy summarization (~30k tokens), RAG Q&A with citations, and fast snippet reranking for search UI. EU data residency required.
Marco (infra): private EU deployment possible. If they want air-gapped on-prem, add ~2 weeks setup + HSM cert work. Dedicated recommended for rerank latency.
Sasha (security): will take the sec questionnaire. Need dataflow diagram and retention limits from sales. SOC2 ok.
Ethan (sales): propose acceptance checklist to confirm with customer:
- Summaries: coherence pass rate >= 90% on 50 samples; ROUGE-L >= 0.58
- QA: citation precision >= 0.85; answer accuracy >= 0.80 on client eval set
- Rerank: NDCG@5 uplift >= 15% vs baseline; p50 snippet latency < 200ms on Dedicated
- Security: Private EU deployment + KMS/HSM + completed questionnaire
Leah (eng): model plan:
- Option A: native 32k-context LLM (quantized) for single-pass summarization and function-calls (best coherence, higher cost)
- Option B: chunk->embed->retrieve->rerank + 8k LLM for final generation (cheaper, reduces hallucination)
- Reranker: small cross-encoder on Dedicated for low-latency ranking
Leah (eng): function calling for structured extraction is supported; we'll test strict schema validation. Example we'll exercise:
```json
{"function":"extract_contract_fields","args_schema":{"contract_id":"string","effective_date":"string","party":"string","summary":"string"}}
```
Marco (infra): private endpoints inside VPC supported, no public egress needed. Documenting network diagram for the customer.
Sasha (security): I'll return questionnaire answers by tomorrow noon and flag any blockers. Need metric retention clause for SOW.
Ethan (sales): evaluation timeline suggestion (4 weeks):
Wk0: ingest + embeddings + baseline runs
Wk1: reranker tuning + offline NDCG eval
Wk2: function-call extraction tests + hallucination sampling
Wk3: latency tuning on Dedicated + A/B tests for summary approaches
Wk4: demo + handoff + accept sign-off
Leah (eng): recommendation: start with retrieve+rerank for Q&A and reranker for UI; reserve 32k runs for the summary acceptance tests to control cost.
Ethan (sales): action items: 1) Sales to get monthly token estimates from customer (for Hosted vs Dedicated pricing) 2) Eng to produce prompt bank + baseline outputs 3) Infra to confirm EU private timeline and air-gap costs 4) Security to complete questionnaire
POC Bot: created workspace https://git.redwood/poc/acme-fin and pushed eval harness.
Ethan (sales): I'll send this checklist to the customer and loop back with volumes. :white_check_mark:
_meta: sales POC scoping thread: acceptance criteria, model options, timelines, security/infra blockers
